title: Labcorp Holdings Inc. Form 8-K dated August 11, 2026
excerpt: Megan Bailey will resign as president of Central Laboratories and International effective September 4; Brian Caveney assumes leadership of Biopharma Laboratory Services effective September 1.
summary: The filing discloses a senior leadership transition in the Biopharma Laboratory Services segment; it changes execution risk but provides no new financial guidance.
